description: Scheduled push reminders for loan installments (non-custodial model, RFC-003, architecture v1.2). Generated in batch when a loan becomes active (T-3, T-1, DUE, OVERDUE_3, OVERDUE_7 per installment) and dispatched by a cron that sends the push and marks sentAt. Reminders for a paid installment are skipped by the dispatcher. UNIQUE (installmentId, reminderType) keeps the cron re-runnable without duplicates.

fields.name: reminderType
fields.description: Allowed values: T-3, T-1, DUE, OVERDUE_3, OVERDUE_7 (days relative to dueDate).

fields.name: scheduledFor
fields.description: When the push should fire (dueDate offset by the reminderType).

fields.name: sentAt
fields.description: NULL until the dispatcher cron sends it — the cron filter is sentAt IS NULL AND scheduledFor <= now.

relationships.notes: Multi-tenant isolation via companyId — injected automatically by stored procedures.
Up to five reminders per installment.

components.name: PaymentReminderListStep
components.description: IonList by companyId ordered by scheduledFor: installmentId, reminderType chip, scheduledFor, sent badge (pending gray / sent green with sentAt).

hints: UNIQUE constraint on (installmentId, reminderType) — batch generation is idempotent.
Extra action 'schedule_for_loan': given a loanId, inserts the five reminder rows per pending installment computing scheduledFor from loanInstallments.dueDate.
Extra action 'due_now': returns unsent reminders with scheduledFor <= GETUTCDATE() joined to the installment and borrower userId for the push; skips installments already paid.
Extra action 'mark_sent': sets sentAt — the only allowed update.
Index (sentAt, scheduledFor) for the dispatcher sweep.
